dialog.title: Import Planestone Sheet
dialog.hint: Choose a Planestone sheet file (.yaml or .json), or paste one below. It can hold NPCs, vehicles, hazards or world items. Nothing is created until you confirm the preview.
dialog.name: Name

patch.title: Patch NPC
patch.hint: Paste a Planestone patch (kind: actorPatch) or load one from a file. Nothing changes until you apply the preview.
patch.itemHint: Paste a Planestone item patch (kind: itemPatch) or load one from a file. Nothing changes until you apply the preview.
patch.copySheetHint: Copy this document's current Planestone sheet (YAML) to the clipboard

aiProvider.name: AI provider
aiProvider.hint: Turns on Prompt Patch and Prompt Sheet. Stored in this browser only.

aiApiKey.name: AI API key
aiApiKey.hint: Your Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter key. Stored in this browser only and sent only to the chosen provider.

aiModel.name: AI model
aiModel.hint: Model id. Leave blank for the default (claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5, or anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 on OpenRouter). OpenRouter ids look like vendor/model.

aiWorldContext.name: AI world context
aiWorldContext.label: Edit world context
aiWorldContext.hint: Setting notes and files sent with every AI prompt. Stored in this browser only, so players never receive them.

worldContext.title: AI World Context
worldContext.hint: Notes about your setting, sent with every Prompt Patch and Prompt Sheet request. For example: humans don’t exist; kobolds are the dominant species. Saved in this browser only; players never receive it.
worldContext.placeholder:
# My world

- no humans; kobolds and lizardfolk run the cities
- iron is rare, most weapons are bone or bronze
worldContext.filesHint: .md or .txt files from the Foundry data folder, read fresh on every prompt. Foundry serves that folder to anyone who knows the path, so keep secret notes in an out-of-the-way folder.

ai.patchHint: Describe the change. The AI sees this document’s current sheet and your world context, and replies with a patch you review before anything changes.
ai.patchPlaceholder: make it level 6 and give it a cold aura
ai.sheetHint: Describe what to create. The AI writes a Planestone sheet using your world context, and you review the import preview before anything is created.
ai.sheetPlaceholder: a level 3 kobold trapmaster with a snare-setting reaction
ai.correctionPlaceholder: Correction or follow-up (optional when you only rejected changes)
ai.refinePlaceholder: Follow-up: what to change in this sheet
ai.newPromptHint: Start over with a new request
ai.correctHint: Send the follow-up; rejected changes are listed for the AI

review.lintHint: Link plain condition names and fix misspelled or legacy [[marks]]. Saved for your user.
review.fixes: Automatic text fixes: untick to reject
review.suggestions: Names not found: did you mean
review.pickFailed: Couldn't find that name in the sheet text
